title: eBPF threat signals from the telemetry you already collect
abstract: Network flows and CPU profiles from eBPF join on one PID to reveal new ports, new peers and code nobody shipped, without writing a single detection rule.

title: Zero-code tracing with OpenTelemetry eBPF Instrumentation
abstract: How OBI produces RED metrics, traces and network flows for any process from the kernel, and where it stops and SDKs take over.

title: Canary analysis that judges each ReplicaSet on its own traffic
abstract: Scoping Argo Rollouts analysis to the pod-template-hash so a regression on 20% of traffic is not diluted by the stable pods.

title: An AI SRE that fixes what your canary catches
abstract: An agent wakes on an aborted rollout, reads metrics, logs and the diff over MCP, and opens a fix PR that a human merges.

title: Search relevance for developer portals
abstract: Hybrid keyword and semantic search with reciprocal rank fusion, tuned with query rules and measured with zero-result rates.

title: Treating your internal developer platform like a product
abstract: Adoption, friction and reliability per plugin, derived in the OpenTelemetry Collector from spans, audit logs and frontend events.

title: Right-sizing workloads without breaking them
abstract: Using requests, limits and observed usage to free capacity, and the traps of CPU limits on latency-sensitive services.

title: Policy as code for AI agents in production
abstract: Sandboxing agents in microVMs and checking every tool call against policy before it runs: allow, block, or ask a human.

title: Multi-cluster GitOps at scale with Argo CD
abstract: ApplicationSets, progressive sync waves and drift detection across hundreds of clusters.

title: Profiling in production with OpenTelemetry profiles
abstract: Continuous CPU profiling at under one percent overhead, and correlating hot functions with traces.

title: Accessible conference tooling for everyone
abstract: Captions, step-free routes, quiet rooms and multilingual content: designing events that work for every attendee.

title: Kubernetes networking demystified
abstract: From pod IPs to Services, Gateway API and eBPF dataplanes, with packet walks you can follow.

title: Vector search on Kubernetes
abstract: Running embedding pipelines and hybrid retrieval next to your workloads, and when to use a managed service instead.

title: Debugging CrashLoopBackOff like an SRE
abstract: Events, logs, probes and resource limits: a systematic path from symptom to root cause.

title: Supply chain security for container images
abstract: Signing, SBOMs and admission policies that keep unsigned images out of production.

title: Platform engineering with paved roads
abstract: Golden paths that developers choose because they are faster, and how to measure that they are.
